**[[Dwarven Mine]] (1 trip) - [[Combat bracelet]] to [[Edgeville Monastery]] or [[Falador Teleport]]
**[[Witchaven]] (1 trip) - [[Ardougne Teleport]], [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|blr}}, or [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4
**[[Jolly Boar Inn]] east of Varrock (1 trip) - [[Lumberyard Teleport]], [[Ring of the elements]] to [[Earth Altar]], [[Balloon transport system]] to [[Varrock]], [[Varrock Teleport]], or [[Digsite Teleport]]
**[[Edgeville]] (1 trip) - [[Amulet of glory]], [[Combat bracelet]] to [[Edgeville Monastery]], [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|dkr}}, or [[Varrock Teleport]]

*Obtaining the cooked fish:
**All raw fish except salmon can be found at [[Frankie's Fishing Emporium]] in Port Piscarilius
**[[Salmon]] can be purchased cooked from the [[West Ardougne General Store]]
**[[Swordfish]] can be purchased cooked from [[The Shrimp and Parrot]] in [[Brimhaven]], and 5 are received as a reward from {{SCP|Quest}} [[Tribal Totem]]
**[[Bass]] can be obtained cooked as a 1/50 drop from [[Ankou]]s, or from [[Gourmet impling]]s with {{SCP|Hunter|28|link=no}} {{Boostable|yes}}. Bass can also be purchased cooked from the [[Warrior Guild Food Shop]].
